reach.rationale: No experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs anywhere; the runtime leans entirely on long-stable Hono 4 / htmx 2 APIs and correctly avoids the hono 5.0.0-rc. The only 'very new' elements are two recently-stable dependency versions: TypeScript 7 (4 months, dev-only) and @hono/node-server v2 (6 months, API-unchanged).

evidence: app/package.json:8,14 — TypeScript 7 is confined to devDependencies and the typecheck script only
app/build.mjs:10-17 — the production build transpiles with esbuild (jsxImportSource hono/jsx), so TS 7 never produces shipped output
app/src/views/home.tsx:63-92 — htmx interactivity is confined to the home filter form plus the move-table swap in pokemon.tsx; everything else is plain SSR
containment.rationale: There is no experimental runtime code to contain; the single near-new tool (TS 7) is isolated in the typecheck-only path behind the build, so a compiler regression cannot affect production output.

evidence: app/package.json:7-9 — hono 4.13.14, @hono/node-server 2.1.5 and htmx.org 2.0.11 are all the exact current stable releases, not RCs (hono 5.0.0-rc.1 exists and was not taken)

justification.rationale: Nothing experimental is used, so nothing to justify; the near-new choices (node-server v2 for its ~2.3x throughput, TS 7 for fast typechecking) each buy something a stable alternative wouldn't, and both are stable releases rather than previews.

findings.issue: TypeScript is pinned to 7.0.2, the native Go compiler released only ~4 months ago (2026-07-08); it dropped all options deprecated in 6.0 and no longer exposes a programmatic JS compiler API, which can break editor tooling that imports the typescript package.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is since esbuild does the real transpiling and tsc only typechecks; if any tooling needs the old JS API, pin it to the @typescript/typescript6 compatibility package.

findings.issue: @hono/node-server v2 is a ~6-month-old major (v2.0.0, ~Apr 2026), the newest major in the runtime dependency set.
findings.suggestion: No action needed: v2's public API is identical to v1 per the release notes, and it is the current stable line; just re-pin deliberately when hono 5 goes stable since node-server 2.1.4+ allows hono v5 peers.

summary: This app is essentially non-experimental: zero unstable, preview, RC or canary APIs, and it deliberately pins the current stable releases (hono 4.13.14, @hono/node-server 2.1.5, htmx 2.0.11) while skipping the available hono 5.0.0-rc. The only near-new elements are two stable-but-recent versions — TypeScript 7 (4 months old, dev-only, with esbuild doing the actual build) and @hono/node-server v2 (6 months, API unchanged). Experimentalness risk is minimal and fully contained to the toolchain.
